contracts.scope: At least two known xsId observations in one caller-declared ad session must agree.
One known xsId must not appear in different caller-declared ad sessions.

source_interpretation: IAS describes an external ID that identifies one ad session uniquely and stays the same across its UVP URLs.
UUIDv4 is a recommendation. Opaque, nonempty, resolved identities remain eligible.
No closed event set, ordering or firing-frequency assertion is added.
input_context: Original zero-based document.artifacts indexes are grouped explicitly by the caller before ordinary deduplication. No host, time, HAR page or corpus-adjacency inference.
limits: Relationship extraction covers direct URL-like original rows matched by the actual registered owner. Serialized HTTP envelopes and JSON are typed skips.
Missing, empty, placeholder, unresolved, conflicting or invalidly encoded identities cannot establish equality or reuse. Known disagreements can still be proven with partially evaluated coverage.
Ungrouped rows, insufficient known observations and excluded owners stay visible in coverage.

64 MiB serialized JSON and aggregate text, 50,000 rows and memberships, 10,000 groups, 100,000 original occurrences and query spans, 4,096-byte labels, two million rule/member work, one million projected collection items and 64 MiB projected retained output strings are local limits.
Grouping accuracy, unseen sessions, destination acceptance and runtime/platform applicability remain external.

tests.expected_results: Static source and boundary expectations authored independently of engine output. No observed corpus detection-gain claim.
